common_lane_contract.input: Exact static-cycle workload generated by frozen previous.workload; four investors, one asset, integer cents, no revisions/corrections, one economic/knowledge cut and exact count manifests. Event count0..100000; seed one of0,11,29,47,71,97 (0 only a boundary-test seed). No arbitrary financial population claim.
common_lane_contract.validation: Same finite_gate for all methods, followed by identical public Store.ingest admission; altered metadata, amount, event identity, report, cut, shape or source is rejected before computation.
common_lane_contract.arithmetic: Independent stdlib signed additions, independent SQLite integer-string parsing and UNION/SUM, or unchanged production reconcile with test-owned save_run projection adapter.
common_lane_contract.output: Exactly the same canonical integer balances/liability/custody/differences/outcomes object; identical common SQLite result schema and JSON export bytes; independent closed-form oracle and reread verification.
common_lane_contract.persistence: Same Store input DB per-row commits/settings for all three. No rich run persisted by any method. Same separate common result DB schema/insert/commit and export.
common_lane_contract.implementation_overhead: Production engine still constructs trace/evidence in RAM before projection. This internal overhead is measured, never relabeled as the complete product's service latency.
common_lane_contract.equivalence_gate: Every size/repeat must have exactly three distinct successful methods and identical input identity, SQLite settings, common result, input DB/result DB/export hashes and code bindings before EQUIVALENT_COMMON_ARITHMETIC. Full product equivalence remains INCONCLUSIVE.
common_lane_contract.shared_dependencies: Shared generation/finite validation, production normalization/ingestion and common persistence are intentional. Arithmetic references/oracle do not call production financial calculation; this is not end-to-end independent validation.

order: Seeded three-method permutation on even repetitions, reverse order on odd repetitions. Match all comparisons by event count, repeat, seed and input SHA.
warmups: One100-event process per method; retained separately and excluded from summaries.
cache_policy: Fresh DB and interpreter every trial, no OS page-cache flush; not cold-disk measurements.
generation: Measured once per paired input; report separately, do not charge identical generation three times.
physical_io: Read /proc/self/io process counters if available; kernel write_bytes on overlayfs is not independent physical device IO or billing. Actual physical-device IO remains NOT_OBSERVABLE.
statistics: Five paired blocks; p50 and empirical nearest-rank p95 (maximum at n5), all original runs retained;2,000 seeded paired-block bootstrap median difference/ratio intervals; exploratory conditional uncertainty, not reliable population tails.
triage: Separate production common-lane runs: reproduce100k end-to-end60s cap first; then25k and50k localize completion boundary. Total180s includes input generation/control overhead; remaining-budget caps may be lower and are recorded. No baseline100k result inferred; no arbitrary raising of60s; old100k60.065s censor remains historical evidence.
timeout: Popen.communicate deadline; kill if still running, then communicate/wait and retain actual returncode/stdout/stderr/last phase/committed receipt count. Never infer or invent POSIX status.
archive_acceptance: Caller selects expected mode, evidence root and reviewed source bindings. Require exact nonempty timed inventory with unique size/repeat/method identities and expected seeds; reject missing/duplicate/substitution, mismatched source/input path/hash/bytes, nonzero PASS, absent actual exit for executed attempts, metric identity/row mismatch, oracle disagreement, false equivalence and PARTIAL relabeling. Recompute derived summaries only from actual PASS trials; zero PASS means no measured medians. Rehash/revalidate actual retained inputs, compare original command/stdout/stderr and metric files, require strict byte/SHA/settings proofs, and reread retained100-event DB/export artifacts. Larger omitted files remain observed hashes, never claimed independently reread. This consistency gate is not cryptographic timing attestation or an institutional trust anchor.
retention: All inputs, commands, original stdout/stderr, metrics/progress and artifact hashes retained. Only100-event measured DB/export bytes retained; larger and failed partial files are hashed/sized then omitted to preserve bounded disk. No existing output path reused.
historical_preservation: Gate1 raw canonical and report remain unchanged:10k21.035740/13.567914/12.854782 seconds;100k timeout60.065 seconds; older missing POSIX exit stays disclosed.
